newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Respironics started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Respironics started at buy.

text.p: -- McDonald & Co said Monday it initiated coverage of Respironics Inc with a buy rating and a 12-18-month price target of $25 a share. The stock was up 5/16 to 20.
-- The company makes sleep therapy and respiratory products for home and hospital use.

-- Analyst Christopher Caton said in a report he believes the company will remain a market leader and gain market share through technological advances that will help home care providers lower their service costs.
-- He estimated earnings will be $1.00 a share in the June-ending year and $1.25 next year versus $0.84 last year.
